llmAnalysis.summary: Well-hardened downloads viewer with no shell execution, no network, and explicit hardening (PlainText, array-form execDetached, absolute-path guards, bounded FolderListModel). All flagged patterns are expected read-only folder enumeration and standard Quickshell IPC. No malicious or privilege-escalation behavior detected.
llmAnalysis.whatItDoes: Adds a download icon to the Omarchy bar with a badge counting files added in the last N minutes. Clicking opens a floating window listing recent downloads (fresh/all filter, age and size) where rows can be dragged via Wayland wl_data_device into browsers/chat apps or double-clicked to open, and right-clicking the bar icon opens the download folder.
llmAnalysis.sequenceDiagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Panel as Panel.qml
    participant Store as DownloadsStore.qml
    participant FLM as FolderListModel
    participant Window as FloatingWindow/ListView
    participant OS as OS (xdg-open / Wayland DnD)
    User->>Panel: shell.json settings (folder, freshMinutes)
    Panel->>Store: applySettings() -> configure() via Util.fileUrl(folder)
    Store->>FLM: scanFolder = folderUrl (StandardPaths.DownloadLocation default)
    FLM-->>Store: folderModel.count / get(i, fileName/fileUrl/fileModified)
    Store->>Store: tick()/rebuild() filter isPartial, cap maxScan 2000 / maxRows 200, compute freshCount
    Store-->>Panel: freshCount -> badge
    Store-->>Window: files, displayPath, fresh state
    User->>Panel: click bar button / IPC summon (jankeesvw.downloads)
    Panel->>Store: toggle()/show() <-> open sync (guarded)
    Store-->>Window: visible = open
    User->>Window: drag row (DownloadRow.qml Drag.Automatic text/uri-list)
    Window->>OS: Wayland start_drag
    User->>Window: double-click row / right-click bar
    Window->>OS: Quickshell.execDetached(["xdg-open", target]) if target[0]=="/"

findings.reasoning: Default writableLocation(DownloadLocation) with override via configure(folder); read-only enumeration for user-visible list, bounded by maxScan/maxRows, no write or exec. Expected for a downloads viewer.
findings.relatedCode: property url folderUrl: StandardPaths.writableLocation(StandardPaths.DownloadLocation) -> readonly property string folderPath -> FolderListModel { folder: root.scanFolder }
findings.executableContext: Not an executable - resolves default download directory; later consumed only as FolderListModel folder and displayPath/xdg-open target

findings.reasoning: Read-only directory listing via Qt.labs.folderlistmodel, showDirs false, Time-sorted newest-first, capped to 2000 entries scanned and 200 rows shown, coalesced tick and polling fallback to avoid UI-thread DoS. No shell or exec.
findings.relatedCode: FolderListModel { folder: root.scanFolder; showDirs: false; sortField: Time } + rebuild() { folderModel.get(i,"fileName"/"fileUrl"/"fileModified") } + if (String(root.scanFolder)==="" || folderModel.status !== Ready) return
findings.executableContext: Not an executable - pure file metadata enumeration; URLs percent-encoded from model and used only for display and drag mimeData

findings.reasoning: Standard Quickshell Panel ipcTarget "jankeesvw.downloads" for summon/open/close; no custom IpcHandler parsing payloads. State sync is guarded both ways (onOpenedChanged if DownloadsStore.open !== root.opened and Connections onOpenChanged) preventing bounce/amplification.
findings.relatedCode: ipcTarget: "jankeesvw.downloads" + onOpenedChanged: if (DownloadsStore.open !== root.opened) DownloadsStore.open = root.opened + Connections { onOpenChanged() { if (DownloadsStore.open && !root.opened) root.open() else if (...) root.close() } }
findings.executableContext: No executable invoked via IPC; exposes only window visibility toggle, not command execution

findings.reasoning: Converts bar setting `folder` string to file:// URL for DownloadsStore.folderUrl; setting comes from shell.json, not IPC. Later use is FolderListModel watch or array-form xdg-open with leading-slash guard, no shell quoting needed.
findings.relatedCode: Panel.qml:69 folder !== "" ? Util.fileUrl(folder) : undefined -> DownloadsStore.configure() -> root.folderUrl / scanFolder + DownloadsStore.qml:257 if (target.charAt(0)==="/") Quickshell.execDetached(["xdg-open", target])
findings.executableContext: xdg-open opens folder/file with system default handler (not arbitrary binary). Args sanitized: array-form execDetached (no bash -lc) and absolute-path check (charAt(0)==="/"), blocks option injection like "-foo"; DownloadRow double-click uses same guard
